articles.title_en: Equitable rent division on a soft budget
articles.title_cn: 软预算约束下的公平租金分配
articles.abstract_en: We study the incentive properties of envy-free mechanisms for the allocation of rooms and payments of rent among financially constrained roommates. Each agent reports their values for rooms, their housing earmark (soft budget), and a coefficient that reflects the difficulty the agent experiences from having to pay over this amount. Then an envy-free allocation for these reports is recommended. The complete information non-cooperative outcomes of each of these mechanisms are exactly the envy-free allocations with respect to true preferences if and only if the admissible budget violation coefficients have a bound.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在财务受限的室友之间分配房间和支付租金的无嫉妒机制的激励性质。每个代理人报告他们对房间的估值、住房专用款项（软预算）以及一个反映代理人因超出此金额而支付所遇困难的系数。然后推荐一个针对这些报告的无嫉妒分配。当且仅当可允许的预算违规系数有界时，这些机制中每一个的完全信息非合作结果恰好是关于真实偏好的无嫉妒分配。

articles.abstract_en: Lab evidence on trust games involves more cooperation than conventional economic theory predicts. We explore whether this pattern extends to a field setting where we are able to control for (lack of) repeat-play and reputation: the taxi market in Mexico City. We find a remarkably high degree of trustworthiness, even with price-haggling which was predicted to reduce trustworthiness.
articles.abstract_cn: 实验室中关于信任博弈的证据显示，合作程度高于传统经济理论的预测。我们探讨这一模式是否延伸至一个能够控制（缺乏）重复博弈和声誉的实地环境：墨西哥城的出租车市场。我们发现，即使在预计会降低可信度的讨价还价情况下，可信度依然非常高。

articles.title_cn: 在控制外部性的同时进行筛选
articles.abstract_en: We propose a tractable framework to introduce externalities in a screening model. Agents differ in both payoff-type and influence-type (ranking how beneficial their actions are for others). Applications range from pricing network goods to regulating industries that create externalities. Inefficiencies arise only if the payoff-type is unobservable. When both dimensions are unobserved, the optimal allocation satisfies lexicographic monotonicity: increasing along the payoff-type to satisfy incentive compatibility, but tilted towards influential agents to move the externality in the socially desirable direction. In particular, the allocation depends on a private characteristic that is payoff-irrelevant for the agent. We characterize the solution through a two-step ironing procedure that addresses the non-monotonicity in virtual values arising from the countervailing impact of payoff- and influence-type. Rents from influence can emerge but only indirectly, i.e. when the observed level of influence is used as a signal of the unobserved payoff-type.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个易处理的框架，将外部性引入筛选模型。代理人既在收益类型上不同，也在影响力类型上不同（即其行为对他人的有益程度排序）。应用范围从网络商品定价到监管产生外部性的行业。只有当收益类型不可观察时，低效率才会出现。当两个维度都不可观察时，最优配置满足字典序单调性：沿收益类型递增以满足激励相容性，但向有影响力的代理人倾斜，以将外部性推向符合社会期望的方向。特别是，配置依赖于对代理人收益无关的私人特征。我们通过一个两步熨烫程序来刻画解，该程序解决了由于收益类型和影响力类型的抵消影响而产生的虚拟价值非单调性。影响力租金可能出现，但仅是间接的，即当观察到的影响力水平被用作未观察到的收益类型的信号时。

articles.title_en: Approximate Bayesian implementation and exact maxmin implementation: An equivalence
articles.title_cn: 近似贝叶斯实施与精确最大最小实施：一种等价性
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a micro-foundation for approximate incentive compatibility using ambiguity aversion. In particular, we propose a novel notion of approximate interim incentive compatibility, approximate local incentive compatibility, and establish an equivalence between approximate local incentive compatibility in a Bayesian environment and exact interim incentive compatibility in the presence of a small degree of ambiguity. We then apply our result to the implementation of efficient allocations. In particular, we identify two economic settings—including ones in which approximately efficient allocations are implementable and ones in which agents are informationally small—in which efficient allocations are approximately locally implementable when agents are Bayesian. Applying our result to those settings, we conclude that efficient allocations are exactly implementable when agents perceive a small degree of ambiguity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用模糊厌恶为近似激励相容性提供了微观基础。具体而言，我们提出了一种新颖的近似 interim 激励相容性概念，即近似局部激励相容性，并建立了贝叶斯环境中的近似局部激励相容性与存在小程度模糊性时的精确 interim 激励相容性之间的等价关系。然后，我们将这一结果应用于有效配置的实施。具体来说，我们识别了两种经济环境——包括近似有效配置可实施的环境以及代理人信息规模较小的环境——在这些环境中，当代理人是贝叶斯型时，有效配置是近似局部可实施的。将我们的结果应用于这些环境，我们得出结论：当代理人感知到小程度的模糊性时，有效配置是精确可实施的。

articles.title_en: God games: An experimental study of uncertainty, superstition, and cooperation
articles.title_cn: 上帝游戏：不确定性、迷信与合作的一项实验研究
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses a novel lab experiment to test claims about the origins and functions of religion. We modify the standard public goods game, adding a computer-based agent that adjusts earnings in ways that might depend on players' contributions. Our treatments employ three different descriptions of the adjustment process that loosely correspond to monotheistic, atheistic, and agnostic interpretations of the computer's role. The adjustments neither mask players' contributions nor magnify their impact. Yet players in all three adjustment treatments contribute much more than those who play the standard public goods game. Players' contributions and survey responses show that adjustments induce superstitions in all treatments, with the strongest superstitions appearing in the quasi-monotheistic treatment and the weakest in the quasi-atheistic treatment. Text-based communication raises contributions and strengthens coordination. But when paired with the quasi-monotheistic description, communication also promotes counterproductive quests for winning numbers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过一项新颖的实验室实验来检验关于宗教起源和功能的论断。我们修改了标准公共品博弈，增加了一个基于计算机的代理，该代理会根据玩家的贡献调整收益。我们的处理采用了三种不同的调整过程描述，大致对应于计算机角色的一神论、无神论和不可知论解释。这些调整既没有掩盖玩家的贡献，也没有放大其影响。然而，在所有三种调整处理中，玩家的贡献都远高于玩标准公共品博弈的玩家。玩家的贡献和调查回应显示，调整在所有处理中都引发了迷信，其中准一神论处理中的迷信最强，准无神论处理中最弱。基于文本的交流提高了贡献并加强了协调。但当与准一神论描述配对时，交流也促进了寻找中奖数字的适得其反的追求。

articles.title_en: Competition and cooperation in linear production and sequencing processes
articles.title_cn: 线性生产与排序过程中的竞争与合作
articles.abstract_en: We analyze applications of biform games to linear production (LP) and sequencing processes. Biform games apply to problems in which strategic decisions are followed by some cooperative game, where the specific environment of the cooperative game is in turn determined by these strategic decisions. In biform LP-processes, we allow firms to compete for resources, rather than assuming the resource bundles are simply given. With strategy dependent resource bundles that can be obtained from two locations, we show that the induced strategic game has a (pure) Nash equilibrium, using the Owen set or any game-theoretic solution concept that satisfies anonymity to solve the cooperative LP-game. In biform sequencing processes, we no longer assume an initial processing order is given. Instead, this initial order is strategically determined. Solving the second-stage cooperative sequencing game using a gain splitting rule, we fully determine the set of Nash equilibria of the induced strategic game.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了双形式博弈在线性生产（LP）和排序过程中的应用。双形式博弈适用于战略决策之后跟随某种合作博弈的问题，其中合作博弈的具体环境又由这些战略决策决定。在双形式LP过程中，我们允许企业竞争资源，而不是假设资源束是简单给定的。通过从两个地点获取的策略依赖资源束，我们证明了所诱导的战略博弈具有（纯）纳什均衡，使用Owen集或任何满足匿名性的博弈论解概念来解决合作LP博弈。在双形式排序过程中，我们不再假设初始处理顺序是给定的。相反，这个初始顺序是战略决定的。使用收益分配规则解决第二阶段的合作排序博弈，我们完全确定了所诱导战略博弈的纳什均衡集。

articles.title_en: The logit dynamic in supermodular games with a continuum of strategies: A deterministic approximation approach
articles.title_cn: 连续策略集超模博弈中的logit动态：一种确定性近似方法
articles.abstract_en: We consider large population supermodular games with pairwise interaction and a continuous strategy set. Our objective is to establish convergence of the logit dynamic in such games to logit equilibria. For this purpose, we apply the deterministic approximation approach, which interprets a deterministic dynamic as an approximation of a stochastic process. We first establish the closeness of this dynamic with a step–wise approximation. We then show that the logit stochastic process is close to the step–wise logit dynamic in a discrete approximation of the original game. Combining the two results, we obtain our deterministic approximation result. We then apply this result to supermodular games. Over finite but sufficiently long time horizons, the logit stochastic process converges to logit equilibria in a discrete approximation of the supermodular game. By the deterministic approximation approach, so does the logit dynamic in the continuum supermodular game.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有成对交互和连续策略集的大规模群体超模博弈。我们的目标是建立此类博弈中logit动态收敛到logit均衡的结果。为此，我们采用确定性近似方法，该方法将确定性动态解释为随机过程的近似。我们首先建立该动态与逐步近似之间的接近性。然后，我们证明在原始博弈的离散近似中，logit随机过程与逐步logit动态是接近的。结合这两个结果，我们得到了确定性近似结果。接着，我们将此结果应用于超模博弈。在有限但足够长的时间范围内，logit随机过程在超模博弈的离散近似中收敛到logit均衡。通过确定性近似方法，连续超模博弈中的logit动态也是如此。

articles.title_en: Public goods games in directed networks
articles.title_cn: 有向网络中的公共品博弈
articles.abstract_en: Public goods games in undirected networks are generally known to have pure Nash equilibria, which are easy to find. In contrast, we prove that, in directed networks, a broad range of public goods games have intractable equilibrium problems: The existence of pure Nash equilibria is NP-hard to decide, and mixed Nash equilibria are PPAD-hard to find. We define general utility public goods games, and prove a complexity dichotomy result for finding pure equilibria, and a PPAD-completeness proof for mixed Nash equilibria. Even in the divisible goods variant of the problem, where existence is easy to prove, finding the equilibrium is PPAD-complete. Finally, when the treewidth of the directed network is appropriately bounded, we prove that polynomial-time algorithms are possible.
articles.abstract_cn: 无向网络中的公共品博弈通常已知具有纯纳什均衡，且易于找到。相比之下，我们证明在有向网络中，广泛的公共品博弈具有棘手的均衡问题：纯纳什均衡的存在性是NP难的，混合纳什均衡是PPAD难的。我们定义了通用效用公共品博弈，并证明了寻找纯均衡的复杂性二分结果，以及混合纳什均衡的PPAD完全性证明。即使在可分割商品变体中，存在性易于证明，找到均衡也是PPAD完全的。最后，当有向网络的树宽适当有界时，我们证明多项式时间算法是可能的。

articles.title_en: On equilibrium uniqueness in generalized multi-prize nested lottery contests
articles.title_cn: 广义多奖嵌套抽奖竞赛中的均衡唯一性
articles.abstract_en: The generalized multiple-prize nested lottery contest framework has been broadly applied to model noisy competitions that award prizes to multiple recipients. Equilibrium existence was not formally established until the recent contribution of Fu et al. (2022). This paper comprehensively examines the equilibrium uniqueness of this contest model. We first consider a multi-prize contest with identical players, a scenario that is commonly assumed in the literature. We verify that a symmetric equilibrium exists and that the equilibrium is unique, which lays a foundation for the numerous studies that adopt this model setting. We then proceed to an asymmetric setting in which players may differ in their prize valuations, impact functions, and/or cost functions. We show that the equilibrium uniqueness persists when players are weakly heterogeneous. However, equilibrium uniqueness may fail—and multiple equilibria may arise—when players are sufficiently heterogeneous.
articles.abstract_cn: 广义多奖嵌套抽奖竞赛框架已被广泛用于模拟向多个获奖者颁发奖项的噪声竞争。均衡存在性直到Fu等人（2022）的近期贡献才被正式确立。本文全面考察了该竞赛模型的均衡唯一性。我们首先考虑一个参与者相同的多奖竞赛，这是文献中普遍假设的情景。我们验证了对称均衡的存在性以及均衡的唯一性，这为众多采用该模型设定的研究奠定了基础。然后我们转向一个不对称设定，其中参与者在奖品估值、影响函数和/或成本函数上可能有所不同。我们表明，当参与者弱异质时，均衡唯一性仍然成立。然而，当参与者充分异质时，均衡唯一性可能失效——并且可能出现多重均衡。

articles.title_en: Heterogeneous facility location with limited resources
articles.title_cn: 有限资源下的异质设施选址
articles.abstract_en: We initiate the study of the heterogeneous facility location problem with limited resources. We mainly focus on the fundamental case where a set of agents are positioned in the line segment [0,1] and have approval preferences over two available facilities. A mechanism takes as input the positions and the preferences of the agents, and chooses to locate a single facility based on this information. We study mechanisms that aim to maximize the social welfare (the total utility the agents derive from facilities they approve), under the constraint of incentivizing the agents to truthfully report their positions and preferences. We consider three different settings depending on the level of agent-related information that is public or private. For each setting, we design deterministic and randomized strategyproof mechanisms that achieve a good approximation of the optimal social welfare, and complement these with nearly-tight impossibility results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开创了对有限资源下异质设施选址问题的研究。我们主要关注一个基本情形：一组代理人位于线段[0,1]上，并对两个可用设施具有批准偏好。机制以代理人的位置和偏好为输入，并基于此信息选择定位单一设施。我们研究在激励代理人如实报告其位置和偏好的约束下，旨在最大化社会福利（代理人从其批准的设施中获得的总效用）的机制。我们根据与代理人相关的信息是公开还是私有的不同水平，考虑了三种不同的设置。对于每种设置，我们设计了确定性和随机策略证明机制，这些机制实现了对最优社会福利的良好近似，并辅以近乎紧的不可可能性结果。
